lines.text: The LORD orders an attack on Merathaim and Pekod, and Babylon is caught in His snare because she challenged Him.
The LORD opens His armory and brings out weapons of wrath, ordering Babylon's granaries broken open and bulls killed.
Refugees declare the vengeance of the LORD in Zion, and archers are summoned to encamp all around Babylon.
A drought will dry up Babylon's waters because of her idols, and she will be overthrown like Jericho and Ai.
An army comes from the north, and a lion rises from the forests of Lebanon to chase Babylon away.
